audience: managers and teams that track working time and absences in TimeTac

useCases.title: See who is clocked in right now
useCases.text: List the timers that run now, with the person and the task. Add the user list to see the department of each person.

useCases.title: Report the hours booked last week
useCases.text: List the time entries of one user or task for a period. Add the project and task lists to group the hours by project.

useCases.title: Review open absence requests
useCases.text: List the absence requests with dates, duration and approval status. Read the absence types to see which kind of leave each request uses.

useCases.title: Start timers and add missing time entries
useCases.text: Start or stop a timer for a user. Or add a finished time entry for a task that the person forgot to book.

useCases.title: Request, approve or reject leave
useCases.text: Create an absence request for an employee. Approve or reject an open request. TimeTac notifies the employee.
